review_candidates.title: L2 Support Engineer

Key Responsibilities ● Provide Level 2 (L2) technical support for platform incidents and service requests. ● Perform initial investigation and platform troubleshooting to identify the source of reported issues. ● Determine whether issues are platform-related, integration-related, or third-party/provider-related, and route or escalate tickets accordingly. ● Own and manage tickets from initial assessment through resolution or proper escalation. ● Apply appropriate ticket classification, prioritization, and support tiering based on severity and business impact. ● Troubleshoot API and integration-related issues, including connectivity, authentication, request/response errors, and system-to-system failures. ● Coordinate with internal technical teams and third-party providers to facilitate timely incident resolution. ● Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, troubleshooting activities, findings, escalations, and resolutions. ● Follow established incident management processes and agreed service levels (SLAs). Support Coverage The role will primarily provide off-hours support, which may include: ● Weekday coverage outside regular business hours ● Weekend and holiday coverage through shifting schedules ● Night or overnight shifts based on the assigned support roster Candidates must be comfortable working on a shifting schedule, including weekends and holidays. Qualifications ● Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. ● Experience in L2 application, platform, production, or technical support. ● Good understanding of incident management, ticketing, escalation, and support tiering. ● Ability to troubleshoot and differentiate between platform, integration, infrastructure, and third-party issues. ● Knowledge of REST APIs and system integrations is highly preferred. ● Familiarity with API troubleshooting tools, HTTP status codes, logs, and API responses is an advantage. ● Experience with ticketing or ITSM platforms such as Jira, ServiceNow, or similar tools is preferred. ● Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. ● Good communication and stakeholder coordination skills. ● Willingness to work shifting schedules, off-hours, weekends, and holidays. Preferred Technical Skills ● API and system integrations ● REST APIs / Postman ● Log analysis and monitoring ● Incident and problem management ● Ticketing / ITSM tools ● Basic SQL and database troubleshooting ● Basic cloud/platform troubleshooting ● Third-party/vendor integration support
